Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion for 1-2 mins just until softened. Add the chicken and fry for 7-10 mins until cooked through and the onions have turned golden. Grate over the ginger, stir through the harissa to coat everything and cook for 1 min more.
Chicken Enchilada Casserole: This is a spectacular Mexican Chicken dish that prominently features enchilada sauce and shredded monterey jack cheese. It also brings together the flavors of corn tortillas and chicken breasts to create a perfectly balanced profile. Cut each chicken breast in about 3 pieces, so that it cooks faster and put it in a small pot. Pour Enchilada sauce over it and cook covered on low to medium heat until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. No water is needed, the chicken will cook in the Enchilada sauce.
Chicken Fajita Mac and Cheese: This is a spectacular United States Chicken dish that prominently features macaroni and chicken stock. It also brings together the flavors of heavy cream, fajita seasoning and salt to create a perfectly balanced profile. Fry your onion, peppers and garlic in olive oil until nicely translucent. Make a well in your veg and add your chicken. Add your seasoning and salt.
Chicken Fried Rice: This is a spectacular Chinese Chicken dish that prominently features chicken thighs and salt. It also brings together the flavors of canola oil, egg and onion to create a perfectly balanced profile. Fried rice is best made with leftover rice that's at least a day old. Otherwise it becomes gummy in the skillet. If you don’t have any leftover rice from the night before, cook a batch of rice and spread it on a large baking sheet or several large plates.
Chicken Ham and Leek Pie: This is a spectacular British Chicken dish that prominently features chicken stock and chicken breast. It also brings together the flavors of butter, leek and garlic to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat the chicken stock in a lidded saucepan. Add the chicken breast and bring to a low simmer. Cover with a lid and cook for 10 minutes.
Chicken Handi: This is a spectacular India Chicken dish that prominently features chicken and onion. It also brings together the flavors of tomatoes, garlic and ginger paste to create a perfectly balanced profile. Take a large pot or wok, big enough to cook all the chicken, and heat the oil in it. Once the oil is hot, add sliced onion and fry them until deep golden brown. Then take them out on a plate and set aside.
Chicken in Orange Sauce Recipe (Pollo a: This is a spectacular Chicken dish that prominently features chicken legs and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of butter, onion and red pepper to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place the olive oil and butter in a large sauce pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onions, red bell pepper and garlic. Cook for about 3 minutes, stirring often until the vegetables are soft.
Chicken Karaage: This is a spectacular Japanese Chicken dish that prominently features chicken and ginger. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, soy sauce and sake to create a perfectly balanced profile. Add the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sake and sugar to a bowl and whisk to combine. Add the chicken, then stir to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Chicken Liver Pate Recipe: This is a spectacular Chicken dish that prominently features chicken liver and bacon. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, onion and ground mustard to create a perfectly balanced profile. Clean livers of sinews and gall. Put into a fireproof casserole with all other ingredients roughly chopped. Season and cover with milk.
Chicken Mandi: This is a spectacular India Chicken dish that prominently features chicken and basmati rice. It also brings together the flavors of water, onion and garlic to create a perfectly balanced profile. 1. Clean and cut the chicken; marinate briefly with salt, turmeric and a little oil. 2.
Chicken Marengo: This is a spectacular France Chicken dish that prominently features olive oil and mushrooms. It also brings together the flavors of chicken legs, passata and chicken stock cube to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish and stir-fry the mushrooms until they start to soften. Add the chicken legs and cook briefly on each side to colour them a little. Pour in the passata, crumble in the stock cube and stir in the olives.
Chicken Parmentier: This is a spectacular France Chicken dish that prominently features potatoes and butter. It also brings together the flavors of double cream, egg yolks and butter to create a perfectly balanced profile. For the topping, boil the potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain and push through a potato ricer, or mash thoroughly. Stir in the butter, cream and egg yolks.
Chicken Quinoa Greek Salad: This is a spectacular Greek Chicken dish that prominently features quinoa and butter. It also brings together the flavors of red chilli, garlic and chicken breast to create a perfectly balanced profile. Cook the quinoa following the pack instructions, then rinse in cold water and drain thoroughly. Meanwhile, mix the butter, chilli and garlic into a paste. Toss the chicken fillets in 2 tsp of the olive oil with some seasoning.
Chicken Shawarma with homemade garlic he: This is a spectacular Saudi Arabian Chicken dish that prominently features chicken breast and garlic. It also brings together the flavors of ground coriander, ground cumin and ground cardomom to create a perfectly balanced profile. 1 Start by cutting your chicken up into reasonably small slices. Grab your ziplock bag and dump the freshly sliced chicken inside. 2 Add garlic, coriander, cumin, cardomom, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, pepper, lemon juice and olive oil to the bag.
Chicken wings with cumin, lemon & garlic: This is a spectacular Turkish Chicken dish that prominently features chicken wings and garlic. It also brings together the flavors of lemon, cumin seeds and olive oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Using a pair of sharp kitchen scissors, cut each wing at the knuckle into two pieces. Mix the garlic, lemon zest and juice, cumin and oil with plenty of seasoning, then tip into a dish with the chicken wings and toss to coat. Cover and put in the fridge to marinate for at least 1 hr, or overnight if you have time.
Chicken with saffron, raisins & pine nut: This is a spectacular Spanish Chicken dish that prominently features chicken and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, saffron and dry sherry to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat a large frying pan on a high heat and season the chicken. Add the olive oil to the pan, then the chicken. Brown for about 5 mins on each side, remove onto a plate, then set aside.
Chickpea Fajitas: This is a spectacular Mexican Vegetarian dish that prominently features chickpeas and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of paprika, tomatoes and red onions to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil. Drain the chickpeas, pat dry and tip onto the prepared baking tray. Add the oil and paprika, toss to coat, then roast for 20-25 mins until browned and crisp, shaking halfway through cooking.
Chickpea, chorizo & spinach stew: This is a spectacular Spanish Pork dish that prominently features extra virgin olive oil and onion. It also brings together the flavors of carrots, celery and thyme to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat the oil in a large pan, then gently fry the onion for 3-4 mins until it begins to soften. Stir in the carrot, celery, thyme and bay leaves. Season, then cook for 2-3 mins, stirring occasionally.
Chilean Dobladitas: This is a spectacular Side dish that prominently features all purpose flour and melted butter. It also brings together the flavors of milk, baking powder and salt to create a perfectly balanced profile. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet. Whisk flour, 1 cup melted butter, milk, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl until begins to pull together.
Chilean Empanada: This is a spectacular Pork dish that prominently features butter and onion. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, dried oregano and cumin to create a perfectly balanced profile. Make the filling: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper; cook and stir until onion is golden brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Add pork and cook until completely browned and crumbly, 7 to 10 minutes more.
Chilean-Style Sopaipillas: This is a spectacular Side dish that prominently features zapallo squash and all purpose flour. It also brings together the flavors of baking powder, salt and melted butter to create a perfectly balanced profile. Peel, seed, and cut zapallo into chunks. Place in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Cook until zapallo is soft and easily pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.
Chilli ginger lamb chops: This is a spectacular Turkish Lamb dish that prominently features garlic and ginger. It also brings together the flavors of lemon juice, olive oil and chili powder to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Put the garlic in a bowl with the ginger, lemon juice, oil, spices and seasoning. Blitz with a hand blender until smooth, then use to coat the lamb chops on both sides. Leave to marinate in the fridge for a couple of hours or overnight.
Chilli prawn linguine: This is a spectacular Italian Pasta dish that prominently features linguine pasta and sugar snap peas. It also brings together the flavors of olive oil, garlic clove and red chilli to create a perfectly balanced profile. Mix the dressing ingredients in a small bowl and season with salt and pepper. Set aside. Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.
Chinese Orange Chicken: This is a spectacular Chinese Chicken dish that prominently features orange and orange juice. It also brings together the flavors of soy sauce, water and rice vinegar to create a perfectly balanced profile. Make the orange sauce: Whisk together sauce ingredients in a medium bowl. Set aside. Prep the chicken: Cut chicken into about 1-inch cubes.
Chinese Tomato Egg Stir Fry: This is a spectacular Chinese Vegetarian dish that prominently features plum tomatoes and vegetable oil. It also brings together the flavors of eggs, sesame seed oil and chicken bouillon powder to create a perfectly balanced profile. You can use chicken broth in place of the chicken bouillon powder. Add 1/4 cup of broth followed by 2 teaspoons of cornstarch dissolved in 1 tablespoPrepare the tomatoes: Slice the tomatoes in half. Remove the tough stem from each half that connects to the vine.
Chinon Apple Tarts: This is a spectacular France Dessert dish that prominently features puff pastry and dark brown soft sugar. It also brings together the flavors of braeburn apples, red wine jelly and creme fraiche to create a perfectly balanced profile. To make the red wine jelly, put the red wine, jam sugar, star anise, clove, cinnamon stick, allspice, split vanilla pod and seeds in a medium saucepan. Stir together, then heat gently to dissolve the sugar. Turn up the heat and boil for 20 mins until reduced and syrupy.
Chivito sandwich: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Beef dish that prominently features milk and butter. It also brings together the flavors of molasses, water and egg to create a perfectly balanced profile. For the brioche buns heat the milk with the butter and molasses until the butter has melted. Add the cold water and egg to this mix. 2 In a large bowl place flour, salt and yeast and mix.
Chivito uruguayo: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Beef dish that prominently features beef brisket and bread. It also brings together the flavors of lettuce, tomato and ham to create a perfectly balanced profile. Crush the meat so that it is finite and we put it on a griddle to brown. Put the eggs, bacon and ham to fry. Cut the bread in half, put the beef brisket, the fried eggs, the bacon, the ham, the mozzarella, the tomato and the lettuce.
Choc Chip Pecan Pie: This is a spectacular United States Dessert dish that prominently features plain flour and butter. It also brings together the flavors of cream cheese, icing sugar and butter to create a perfectly balanced profile. First, make the pastry. Tip the ingredients into a food processor with 1 /4 tsp salt. Blend until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Chocolate alfajores: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Dessert dish that prominently features butter and sugar. It also brings together the flavors of egg, honey and all purpose flour to create a perfectly balanced profile. For the cookies cream the butter with the sugar for a few minutes. Then add the egg and honey and mix well. Add flour, cornstarch, cocoa, baking soda and baking powder and mix until you get a dough.
Chocolate Avocado Mousse: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features banana and cacao. It also brings together the flavors of avocado, honey and lemon juice to create a perfectly balanced profile. 1. Blend all the mousse ingredients together in your food processor until smooth. Add the cacao powder first and, as you blend, have all the ingredients to hand in order to adjust the ratios slightly as the size of avocados and bananas varies so much.
Chocolate Caramel Crispy: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features mars bar and butter. It also brings together the flavors of rice krispies and milk chocolate to create a perfectly balanced profile. Grease and line a 20 x 20cm/8" x 8" baking tin with parchment paper. Put the mars bars and butter in a heat proof bowl and place over a pan of barely simmering water. Mixing with a whisk, melt until the mixture is smooth.
Chocolate churros with chocolate & salte: This is a spectacular Spanish Dessert dish that prominently features sunflower oil and ice cream. It also brings together the flavors of muscovado sugar, butter and double cream to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 To make the sauce, tip the sugar and butter into a saucepan and bring to a simmer until the sugar has melted, then stir in the cream and simmer until you have a smooth sauce, about 2-3 mins. Remove from the heat, stir through a pinch of sea salt and the chocolate, and continue to stir for 2-3 mins, or until it has completely melted. Keep warm or leave to cool for reheating later.
Chocolate Coconut Squares: This is a spectacular Australian Dessert dish that prominently features butter and caster sugar. It also brings together the flavors of egg, self-raising flour and baking powder to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Butter and line the base of a 20cm square baking tin. Beat together the butter and sugar until pale and creamy, then beat in the eggs.
Chocolate empanadas: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Dessert dish that prominently features condensed milk and all purpose flour. It also brings together the flavors of unsweetened cocoa, salt and butter to create a perfectly balanced profile. For the filling place the can in a large pot and cover completely with water. Boil for two and a half hours, occassionally adding water. Let cool before opening.
Chocolate Gateau: This is a spectacular France Dessert dish that prominently features plain chocolate and butter. It also brings together the flavors of milk, eggs and granulated sugar to create a perfectly balanced profile. Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/Gas Mark 4. Grease and line the base of an 8 in round spring form cake tin with baking parchment Break the chocolate into a heatproof bowl and place over a saucepan of gently simmering water and stir until it melts. (or melt in the microwave for 2-3 mins stirring occasionally) Place the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl and cream together with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy.
Chocolate Raspberry Brownies: This is a spectacular United States Dessert dish that prominently features dark chocolate and milk chocolate. It also brings together the flavors of salted butter, light brown soft sugar and eggs to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Line a 20 x 30cm baking tray tin with baking parchment. Put the chocolate, butter and sugar in a pan and gently melt, stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon.
Chocolate Souffle: This is a spectacular France Dessert dish that prominently features single cream and caster sugar. It also brings together the flavors of dark chocolate, butter and butter to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7 and place a baking tray on the top shelf. For the sauce, heat the cream and sugar until boiling. Remove from the heat, stir in the chocolate and butter until melted, then keep warm.
Chorba Hamra bel Frik (Algerian Lamb, To: This is a spectacular Algerian Lamb dish that prominently features freekeh and lamb. It also brings together the flavors of onion, black pepper and paprika to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place freekeh in a small bowl and cover with cold water. Set aside. Combine lamb, onion, black pepper, paprika, cinnamon, and salt in a pot.
Choripán: This is a spectacular Argentina Pork dish that prominently features chorizo and crusty bread. It also brings together the flavors of chimichurri sauce to create a perfectly balanced profile. Grill the Chorizos: Cook the chorizos on a grill or pan until fully cooked, about 10-15 minutes. Prepare the Rolls: Slice the rolls and toast them lightly on the grill or in a pan. Assemble: Slice each chorizo lengthwise and place in a roll.
Chorizo & chickpea soup: This is a spectacular Spanish Pork dish that prominently features tinned tomatos and chorizo. It also brings together the flavors of savoy cabbage, chilli flakes and chickpeas to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Put a medium pan on the heat and tip in the tomatoes, followed by a can of water. While the tomatoes are heating, quickly chop the chorizo into chunky pieces (removing any skin) and shred the cabbage. step 2 Pile the chorizo and cabbage into the pan with the chilli flakes and chickpeas, then crumble in the stock cube.
Chorizo & soft-boiled egg salad: This is a spectacular Spanish Pork dish that prominently features baby new potatoes and egg. It also brings together the flavors of green beans, chorizo and garlic clove to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Cook the potatoes in a large pan of boiling salted water for 12 mins, adding the eggs after 6 mins, and the beans for the final 2 mins. Drain everything and cool the eggs under cold running water. step 2 Meanwhile fry chorizo slices for 1-2 mins, until beginning to crisp.
Chorizo & tomato salad: This is a spectacular Spanish Pork dish that prominently features beef tomatoes and red onions. It also brings together the flavors of thyme, sherry vinegar and extra virgin olive oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Put the tomatoes in a bowl with the onion and thyme. Season, then drizzle with the vinegar and oil. Let the flavours mingle while you cook the chorizo.
Chorizo, potato & cheese omelette: This is a spectacular Spanish Pork dish that prominently features potatoes and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of chorizo, egg and parsley to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Cook the potato in boiling water for 8-10 mins or until tender. Drain and allow to steam-dry. Heat oil in an omelette pan, add chorizo and cook for 2 mins.
Christmas cake: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features butter and muscovado sugar. It also brings together the flavors of plain flour, eggs and ground almonds to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Line the base and sides of a 20 cm round, 7.5 cm deep cake tin. Beat the butter and sugar with an electric hand mixer for 1-2 mins until very creamy and pale in colour, scraping down the sides of the bowl half way through.
Christmas Pudding Flapjack: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features salted butter and dark soft brown sugar. It also brings together the flavors of golden syrup, orange and rolled oats to create a perfectly balanced profile. Preheat the oven to 180°C/fan 160°C/gas mark 4 and grease and line a 25cm x 20cm tin. Melt the butter, sugar, syrup and orange zest in a large saucepan over a medium heat. The aim is to dissolve all the ingredients so that they are smooth, but to not lose any volume through boiling so be careful not to overheat.
Christmas Pudding Trifle: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features orange and demerara sugar. It also brings together the flavors of grand marnier, christmas pudding and custard to create a perfectly balanced profile. Peel the oranges using a sharp knife, ensuring all the pith is removed. Slice as thinly as possible and arrange over a dinner plate. Sprinkle with the demerara sugar followed by the Grand Marnier and set aside.
Chtitha Batata (Algerian Potato Stew): This is a spectacular Algerian Vegetarian dish that prominently features garlic and red chilli. It also brings together the flavors of ground cumin, paprika and black pepper to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat a large saucepan over medium heat and stir-fry dersa until fragrant, 2 to 4 minutes.
Chuletas de Cerdo a la Criolla (Pork Cho: This is a spectacular Pork dish that prominently features pork chops and vegetable oil. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, mustard and ground cumin to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place the pork chops in a zip lock plastic bag. Add the mustard, cumin, garlic, salt and pepper. Refrigerate for 1 hour or overnight.
Churros: This is a spectacular Spanish Dessert dish that prominently features butter and vanilla extract. It also brings together the flavors of plain flour, baking powder and sunflower oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Boil the kettle, then measure 300ml boiling water into a jug and add the melted butter and vanilla extract. Sift the flour and baking powder into a big mixing bowl with a big pinch of salt. Make a well in the centre, then pour in the contents of the jug and very quickly beat into the flour with a wooden spoon until lump-free.
Cinnamon buns: This is a spectacular Norway Dessert dish that prominently features unsalted butter and milk. It also brings together the flavors of salt, flour and strong white flour to create a perfectly balanced profile. In a small saucepan heat the butter, milk and salt until the butter is melted. Allow the mixture to cool until it is lukewarm. In a large bowl, stir together the flours, yeast, cardamom and sugar until combined.
Cinnamon Roll Cookies: This is a spectacular Dessert dish that prominently features plain flour and unsalted butter. It also brings together the flavors of caster sugar, egg and salt to create a perfectly balanced profile. 1) In a large bowl, combine the butter and caster sugar until creamy. Add the egg and a pinch of salt. 2) Stir into a buttery mixture.
Clam chowder: This is a spectacular United States Starter dish that prominently features clams and butter. It also brings together the flavors of bacon, onion and thyme to create a perfectly balanced profile. Rinse the clams in several changes of cold water and drain well. Tip the clams into a large pan with 500ml of water. Cover, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 mins until the clams have just opened.
Clam, chorizo & white bean stew: This is a spectacular Spanish Seafood dish that prominently features chorizo and onion. It also brings together the flavors of garlic clove, parsley and vegetable stock to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Fry the chorizo in a large frying pan with a lid, over a medium heat until it is starting to crisp up and release its oil. Add the onion and cook for 5 mins until starting to soften. Then add the garlic and finely chopped parsley, and fry for 1 min more.
Classic Christmas pudding: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features almonds and bramley apples. It also brings together the flavors of candied peel, nutmeg and raisins to create a perfectly balanced profile. Get everything for the pudding prepared. Chop the almonds coarsely. Peel, core and chop the cooking apples.
Classic Tourtière: This is a spectacular Canadian Beef dish that prominently features canola oil and onion. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, ground beef and ground pork to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oil on medium-high heat in a large sauté pan or skillet, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the ground beef, pork, and spices and cook until the meat is browned. Add the beef broth and bring it up to a simmer then reduce heat to medium low.
Clear Soup with Semolina Dumplings: This is a spectacular Miscellaneous dish that prominently features semolina and butter. It also brings together the flavors of egg, salt and nutmeg to create a perfectly balanced profile. Step 1 Allow butter to come to room temperature before beating in a bowl until creamed. Season with salt and a small, delicate pinch of nutmeg. Step 2 Add in the egg, stirring vigorously.
Coconut Natilla Recipe: This is a spectacular Dessert dish that prominently features milk and cornstarch. It also brings together the flavors of cornstarch, coconut milk and coconut to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place 1 cup of milk in a small bowl, add the cornstarch and stir to dissolve it, then set aside. Place the coconut milk and grated coconut in the blender and blend until smooth and set aside. Place the rest of the milk and cinnamon sticks in a medium pot and bring the mixture to boil over medium-low heat.
Coconut quindim: This is a spectacular Dessert dish that prominently features butter and egg yolks. It also brings together the flavors of caster sugar, coconut milk and desiccated coconut to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Rub 4 ramekins, about 175ml capacity, or dariole moulds liberally with the soft butter. Sprinkle with the caster sugar to coat.
Coddled pork with cider: This is a spectacular Irish Pork dish that prominently features butter and pork chops. It also brings together the flavors of bacon, potatoes and carrots to create a perfectly balanced profile. STEP 1 Heat the butter in a casserole dish until sizzling, then fry the pork for 2-3 mins on each side until browned. Remove from the pan. STEP 2 Tip the bacon, carrot, potatoes and swede into the pan, then gently fry until slightly coloured.
Colombian Buñuelos Recipe: This is a spectacular Side dish that prominently features vegetable oil and cornstarch. It also brings together the flavors of tapioca, feta and farmers cheese to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place all the ingredients, except the oil in a medium bowl and mix well using your hands until soft and smooth dough is obtained. Form small balls using your hands. In a deep pot, heat the vegetable oil to 300°F (Warm, not very hot).
Colombian Style Stuffed Potatoes: This is a spectacular Starter dish that prominently features vegetable oil and potatoes. It also brings together the flavors of salt, olive oil and tomato to create a perfectly balanced profile. Peel the potatoes and cut them into chunks, put them in a medium pot and cover with water and ¼ teaspoon of salt. Bring the potatoes to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce the heat to medium and cook until fork tender about 20 minutes. Drain the potatoes and mash with a fork or masher and set aside.
Conch Fritters: This is a spectacular Seafood dish that prominently features conchs and green pepper. It also brings together the flavors of red pepper, onion and chilli to create a perfectly balanced profile. Note: Make the conch mix the day before and store in the refrigerator to allow time for flavours to meld together. Tartar sauce can also be prepared beforehand. Just combine all the ingredients and mix well.
Conch Stew: This is a spectacular Seafood dish that prominently features conchs and onion. It also brings together the flavors of green pepper, red pepper and scallions to create a perfectly balanced profile. Conch Stew Cooking Directions Clean conch meat and pound to tenderize. Boil conch for 2 - 3 hours or until tender. Make Sea Pie while conch cooks (instructions below).
Coq au vin: This is a spectacular France Chicken dish that prominently features olive oil and bacon. It also brings together the flavors of shallots, chicken legs and chicken thighs to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large, heavy-based saucepan or flameproof dish. Tip in the bacon and fry until crisp. Remove and drain on kitchen paper.
Corba: This is a spectacular Turkish Side dish that prominently features lentils and onion. It also brings together the flavors of carrots, tomato puree and cumin to create a perfectly balanced profile. Pick through your lentils for any foreign debris, rinse them 2 or 3 times, drain, and set aside. Fair warning, this will probably turn your lentils into a solid block that you’ll have to break up later In a large pot over medium-high heat, sauté the olive oil and the onion with a pinch of salt for about 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the tomato paste and stir it around for around 1 minute.
Corn on the cob with lime, green chilli: This is a spectacular Side dish that prominently features vegetable stock and corn on the cob. Slip in the cobs, leave to cook for about five minutes, then turn off the heat and leave the corn to sit in the stock as it cools. Put a heavy-based dry frying pan on a high heat and, once hot, lay the drained corn in the pan and char for a couple of minutes on each side – you’ll probably need to cook them two or three at a time, so you don’t overcrowd the pan.
Corned Beef and Cabbage: This is a spectacular Irish Beef dish that prominently features beef brisket and small potatoes. It also brings together the flavors of carrots and cabbage to create a perfectly balanced profile. 1 Place corned beef in large pot or Dutch oven and cover with water. Add the spice packet that came with the corned beef. Cover pot and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Corned Beef and Cabbage – Jamaican Style: This is a spectacular Jamaican Beef dish that prominently features olive oil and cabbage. It also brings together the flavors of green pepper, onion and garlic to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat olive oil in a skillet or Dutch pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and green pepper and sauté for about 3-5 minutes. Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute.
Corned Beef Hash: This is a spectacular British Beef dish that prominently features unsalted butter and onion. It also brings together the flavors of corned beef, potatoes and kosher salt to create a perfectly balanced profile. Sauté the onions: Heat butter in a large skillet (preferably cast iron) on medium heat. Add the onion and cook a few minutes, until translucent. Add the potatoes and corned beef: Mix in the chopped corned beef and potatoes.
Cornes de Gazelle (Gazelle Horns): This is a spectacular Algerian Dessert dish that prominently features almonds and sugar. It also brings together the flavors of sugar, ground cinnamon and egg to create a perfectly balanced profile. Preheat oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread almonds over the baking sheet.
Cottage Cheese And Feta Stuffed Peppers: This is a spectacular Vegetarian dish that prominently features red pepper and feta. It also brings together the flavors of cottage cheese, chives and parsley to create a perfectly balanced profile. Cut the peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds. In a bowl combine 3.5 oz (100 grams) Feta cheese, 7 oz (200 grams) cottage cheese, 1 tbsp chopped chives (optional), 1 tbsp chopped parsley (optional), 1/4 tsp salt (more or less to taste) and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Fill the peppers with the mixture.
Cream Cheese Tart: This is a spectacular United States Starter dish that prominently features flour and butter. It also brings together the flavors of egg, salt and cheese to create a perfectly balanced profile. Crust: make a dough from 250g flour (I like mixing different flours like plain and wholegrain spelt flour), 125g butter, 1 egg and a pinch of salt, press it into a tart form and place it in the fridge. Filling: stir 300g cream cheese and 100ml milk until smooth, add in 3 eggs, 100g grated parmesan cheese and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg. Take the crust out of the fridge and prick the bottom with a fork.
Creamy Aji green sauce: This is a spectacular Vegetarian dish that prominently features coriander and jalapeno. It also brings together the flavors of spring onions, garlic and white wine vinegar to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Put all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and mix into a sauce. Add seasoning, then pour into a serving bowl.
Creamy Corn Soup Recipe: This is a spectacular Vegetarian dish that prominently features corn on the cob and water. It also brings together the flavors of chicken stock cube, garlic and salt to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place the corn, water, chicken or vegetable bouillon, garlic, salt, pepper, cilantro, potatoes and scallions in a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for approximately 4 minutes or until the corn is tender. Remove from the heat.
Creamy Mustard Chicken: This is a spectacular Chicken dish that prominently features chicken legs and paprika. It also brings together the flavors of salt, black pepper and olive oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. Pat the chicken dry and season the pieces with salt, pepper and paprika. Irish stew: This is a spectacular Irish Beef dish that prominently features whole wheat and lamb loin chops. Jajek: This is a spectacular Side dish that prominently features yogurt and cold water. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, salt and dried mint to create a perfectly balanced profile. Jam jam cookies: This is a spectacular Canadian Dessert dish that prominently features egg and butter. Jam Roly-Poly: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features butter and self-raising flour. Jamaican Boiled Dumplings: This is a spectacular Jamaican Side dish that prominently features water and salt. Three Fish Pie: This is a spectacular British Seafood dish that prominently features potatoes and butter. Three-cheese souffles: This is a spectacular France Miscellaneous dish that prominently features butter and parmesan. Timbits: This is a spectacular Canadian Dessert dish that prominently features flour and sugar. Tirolean Dumplings: This is a spectacular Pork dish that prominently features bread and milk. Toad In The Hole: This is a spectacular British Pork dish that prominently features sausages and vegetable oil. Tofu, greens & cashew stir-fry: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Vegetarian dish that prominently features vegetable oil and broccoli. Tom kha gai: This is a spectacular Thai Chicken dish that prominently features chicken stock and coconut milk. Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns: This is a spectacular Thai Seafood dish that prominently features chicken stock and lemongrass. It also brings together the flavors of galangal, coriander and makrut lime leaves to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Bring the stock to a boil in a medium-sized saucepan. Add the lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots and lime leaves, then simmer for 2 mins. step 2 Add the prawns, fish sauce, chillies and lime juice, then return to the boil.
Tom yum soup with prawns: This is a spectacular Thai Seafood dish that prominently features onion and tomato. It also brings together the flavors of red chilli, galangal and lemongrass stalks to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Pour 1.3 litres water into a large saucepan over a high heat. Add the onion, tomato, chilli, galangal, lemongrass, prawn heads and chicken stock cube. Stir and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 20 mins until the liquid has reduced.
Tonkatsu pork: This is a spectacular Japanese Pork dish that prominently features pork chops and flour. It also brings together the flavors of eggs, breadcrumbs and vegetable oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. STEP 2 Put the flour, eggs and panko breadcrumbs into three separate wide-rimmed bowls.
Torrijas: This is a spectacular Breakfast dish that prominently features orange and lemon. It also brings together the flavors of whole milk, sugar and cinnamon stick to create a perfectly balanced profile. Finely grate the zest of 1 medium orange (about 2 teaspoons) and 1 medium lemon (about 1 teaspoon) into a medium saucepan. Add 1 quart whole milk, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, and 1 (3-inch) cinnamon stick. Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Torrijas with sherry: This is a spectacular Spanish Breakfast dish that prominently features egg and double cream. It also brings together the flavors of milk, golden caster sugar and sweet sherry to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 In a wide, shallow bowl, beat the eggs with the cream, milk, golden caster sugar and sherry. Cut each slice of bread in two and dip them into the egg mix, turning to make sure they get a good coating on either side. Soak bread in egg mixture for 10 mins to absorb the liquid (carefully turn them over from time to time and make sure they don’t get too soggy).
Torta de fiambre: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Pork dish that prominently features cheddar cheese and ham. Preheat oven to 220 degrees Celsius. 2 Grate the cheese and take out the ham.
Tortang Talong: This is a spectacular Filipino Vegetarian dish that prominently features egg plants and eggs. It also brings together the flavors of salt and olive oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. 0. Grill the eggplant until the color of skin turns almost black 1. Let the eggplant cool for a while then peel off the skin.
Tourtiere: This is a spectacular Canadian Pork dish that prominently features potatoes and sunflower oil. It also brings together the flavors of minced pork, onion and garlic clove to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Boil the potato until tender, drain and mash, then leave to cool. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, add the mince and onion and quickly fry until browned.
Traditional Croatian Goulash: This is a spectacular Croatian Beef dish that prominently features beef and onions. Traditional Dutch rice tart (rijstevlaai: This is a spectacular Dessert dish that prominently features flour and coconut oil. It also brings together the flavors of vegetable millk, yeast and sugar to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat the oven to 180°C. For the dough, mix flour and sugar in a bowl. Heat the 100 grams of milk to lukewarm and dissolve the yeast in it.
Treacle Tart: This is a spectacular British Dessert dish that prominently features plain flour and butter. It also brings together the flavors of golden syrup, breadcrumbs and lemons to create a perfectly balanced profile. First make the short crust pastry: measure the flour into a large bowl and rub in the butter with your fingertips until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs (alternatively, this can be done in a food processor). Add about three tablespoons of cold water and mix to a firm dough, wrap in cling film and chill in the fridge for about 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 200C/400F/Gas 6 and put a heavy baking tray in the oven to heat up.
Trinxat (Potato, Cabbage and Bacon Hash): This is a spectacular Pork dish that prominently features cabbage and russet potato. It also brings together the flavors of bacon, garlic and parsley to create a perfectly balanced profile. Bring salted water to boil in a large pot. Add in the cabbage and potatoes, cook until tender about 30-40 minutes When tender, drain, very well. Return the vegetables to the pot and turn on the burner to low.
Tuna and Egg Briks: This is a spectacular Tunisian Seafood dish that prominently features olive oil and spring onions. It also brings together the flavors of spinach, filo pastry and tuna to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a large saucepan and cook the spring onions over a low heat for 3 minutes or until beginning to soften. Add the spinach, cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook for a further 2–3 minutes or until tender and wilted, stirring once or twice. Tip the mixture into a sieve or colander and leave to drain and cool.
Tuna Nicoise: This is a spectacular France Seafood dish that prominently features potatoes and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of eggs, red wine vinegar and capers to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Toss the potatoes with 2 tsp oil and some seasoning. Tip onto a large baking tray, then roast for 20 mins, stirring halfway, until crisp, golden and cooked through.
Tunisian Lamb Soup: This is a spectacular Tunisian Lamb dish that prominently features lamb mince and garlic. It also brings together the flavors of onion, spinach and tomato puree to create a perfectly balanced profile. Add the lamb to a casserole and cook over high heat. When browned, remove from the heat and set aside. Keep a tablespoon of fat in the casserole and discard the rest.
Tunisian Orange Cake: This is a spectacular Tunisian Dessert dish that prominently features orange and caster sugar. Cut off the hard bits from the top and bottom of the orange.
Turkey Bánh mì: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Miscellaneous dish that prominently features baguette and chicken liver. In a small bowl, combine the ginger, rice vinegar, sugar and a few pinches of salt. Pour over the vegetables and toss together.
Turkey Meatloaf: This is a spectacular British Miscellaneous dish that prominently features olive oil and onion. It also brings together the flavors of garlic, worcestershire sauce and tomato puree to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the onion for 8-10 mins until softened. Add the garlic, Worcestershire sauce and 2 tsp tomato purée, and stir until combined.
Turkish lahmacun: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Beef dish that prominently features strong white bread flour and fast action yeast. It also brings together the flavors of corn flour, tomato and green chilli to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Sift the flour into a large bowl, make a well in the middle and sprinkle in the yeast. Pour 125ml water over the yeast, then flick flour over the liquid to create a layer. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place for 15 mins until cracks appear on the surface of that layer.
Turkish lamb pilau: This is a spectacular Turkish Lamb dish that prominently features pine nuts and olive oil. It also brings together the flavors of onion, cinnamon and lamb to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Dry-fry the pine nuts or almonds in a large pan until lightly toasted, then tip onto a plate. Add the oil to the pan, then fry the onion and cinnamon together until starting to turn golden. Turn up the heat, stir in the lamb, fry until the meat changes colour, then tip in the rice and cook for 1 min, stirring all the time.
Turkish rice (vermicelli rice): This is a spectacular Turkish Miscellaneous dish that prominently features rice and vegetable oil. It also brings together the flavors of vermicelli pasta, unsalted butter and chicken stock to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Pour the rice into a very large bowl under cold running water and carefully drain the water out of the bowl through a sieve. Repeat a few times until the water in the bowl is clear, then fill the bowl up with cold water and leave rice to soak for 10 mins while you cook the vermicelli. step 2 Put the oil into a medium pan over medium heat.
Turkish-style lamb: This is a spectacular Turkish Lamb dish that prominently features lamb leg and seasoning. It also brings together the flavors of dried oregano, mint and yogurt to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat grill to high. Season the lamb, then grill for 2 mins on each side until browned, but still very rare. Meanwhile, mix the seasoning, oregano and half of the mint into one of the tubs of yogurt, smother this over the lamb, then return to the grill for another 2-3 mins or until the yogurt is blistered and the meat is cooked to your liking.
Ugali – Kenyan cornmeal: This is a spectacular Kenyan Breakfast dish that prominently features water and white cornmeal. Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Reduce the heat to low, and stirring constantly with a whisk, slowly add the cornmeal to the boiling water. The ugali will begin to thicken quite quickly.
Vanilla alfajores: This is a spectacular Uruguayan Dessert dish that prominently features dulce de leche and coconut flakes. It also brings together the flavors of butter, sugar and egg to create a perfectly balanced profile. For the sandwich cookie cream the soft butter for about a minute, then add the sugar and cream for another two minutes. Incorporate the egg fully before mixing in the egg yolk. Once everything is nicely combined, add all remaining ingredients and mix one more time.
Vegan banh mi: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Vegan dish that prominently features raw vegetables and vegan white wine vinegar. It also brings together the flavors of golden caster sugar, baguette and hummus to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Put the shredded veg in a bowl and add the vinegar, sugar and 1 tsp salt. Toss everything together, then set aside to pickle quickly while you prepare the rest of the sandwich. step 2 Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.
Vegan Chocolate Cake: This is a spectacular United States Vegan dish that prominently features self-raising flour and coco sugar. Vegan Lasagna: This is a spectacular Italian Vegan dish that prominently features green red lentils and carrots. Vegetable Shepherds Pie: This is a spectacular Irish Beef dish that prominently features potatoes and small potatoes. Vegetarian Casserole: This is a spectacular British Vegetarian dish that prominently features rapeseed oil and onion. Vegetarian Chilli: This is a spectacular British Vegetarian dish that prominently features roasted vegetables and kidney beans. Vegetarian Shakshuka: This is a spectacular Saudi Arabian Vegetarian dish that prominently features red onions and red pepper. Venetian Duck Ragu: This is a spectacular Italian Pasta dish that prominently features olive oil and duck legs. It also brings together the flavors of onions, garlic and cinnamon to create a perfectly balanced profile. Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the duck legs and brown on all sides for about 10 mins. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Venezuelan Arepas: This is a spectacular Venezuela Side dish that prominently features cornmeal and water. Venezuelan Coconut Chicken: This is a spectacular Venezuela Chicken dish that prominently features chicken breasts and onion. Venezuelan Sancocho: This is a spectacular Venezuela Beef dish that prominently features hind shank and onion. It also brings together the flavors of pepper, garlic and garlic to create a perfectly balanced profile. Cook for 45-60 minutes until the meat is fork-tender. NOTE: the meat can take a bit longer to be fork-tender; that is okay, just add more cooking time if necessary.
Venezuelan Shredded Beef: This is a spectacular Venezuela Beef dish that prominently features skirty steak and garlic. It also brings together the flavors of onion, onion and red pepper to create a perfectly balanced profile. Beef should be tender enough to so easily. If not, cook for another 10 minutes Press the saute button of the Instant pot.
Venezuelan turnovers: This is a spectacular Venezuela Side dish that prominently features ground beef and pepper. Cook meat until pink is gone.
Vietnamese caramel trout: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Seafood dish that prominently features golden caster sugar and fish sauce. Vietnamese chicken salad: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Chicken dish that prominently features rice noodles and carrots. It also brings together the flavors of cucumber, chicken breasts and radish to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 To make the dressing, whisk all the ingredients together in a large serving bowl. Cook the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and add to the bowl with the dressing. step 2 Peel the carrot into long strips using a vegetable peeler.
Vietnamese Grilled Pork (bun-thit-nuong): This is a spectacular Vietnamese Pork dish that prominently features pork and rice vermicelli. Mince garlic and shallots.
Vietnamese lamb shanks with sweet potato: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Lamb dish that prominently features ground nut oil and lamb shanks. Vietnamese pork salad: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Pork dish that prominently features golden caster sugar and lime. It also brings together the flavors of red chilli, coriander and sesame seed oil to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 The day before: make the dressing. Vietnamese prawn spiralized rolls: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Seafood dish that prominently features lime and rice vinegar. It also brings together the flavors of palm sugar, fish sauce and birds-eye chillies to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Mix all the ingredients for the dipping sauce along with 50ml water in a bowl and set aside to allow the sugar to dissolve and flavour to infuse. step 2 To assemble the rolls, fill a wide bowl with warm water and grab a clean damp tea towel to work on. Vietnamese veg parcels: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Vegetarian dish that prominently features rice flour pancakes and rice noodles. Vietnamese-style caramel pork: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Pork dish that prominently features ground nut oil and pork shoulder steaks. Vietnamese-style veggie hotpot: This is a spectacular Vietnamese Vegetarian dish that prominently features vegetable oil and ginger. Walnut Roll Gužvara: This is a spectacular Croatian Dessert dish that prominently features flour and caster sugar. Walnut, date & honey cake: This is a spectacular Turkish Dessert dish that prominently features self-raising flour and ground cinnamon. Warm roast asparagus salad: This is a spectacular Australian Pork dish that prominently features asparagus and red wine vinegar. Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus and discard. Arrange the asparagus in a single layer in a baking tray with sides.
White chocolate creme brulee: This is a spectacular France Dessert dish that prominently features double cream and white chocolate chips. Take off the heat and allow to infuse for 10 mins, scraping the pod seeds into the cream. If using the vanilla extract, add straight away.
Wontons: This is a spectacular Chinese Pork dish that prominently features pork and garlic clove. Yaki Udon: This is a spectacular Japanese Vegetarian dish that prominently features udon noodles and sesame seed oil. (As they are so thick, adding cold water helps them to cook a little bit slower so the middle cooks through).
Yemeni Lahsa (Elite Shakshuka): This is a spectacular Saudi Arabian Breakfast dish that prominently features egg and onion. Yorkshire Puddings: This is a spectacular British Miscellaneous dish that prominently features flour and egg. Zapiekanki: This is a spectacular Polish Pork dish that prominently features baguette and butter. It also brings together the flavors of vegetable oil, onion and mushrooms to create a perfectly balanced profile. step 1 Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bake the baguettes on a baking tray for 8-10 mins, then leave to cool. step 2 Heat 2 tsp of the butter and 1 tsp of the oil in a pan over a low heat and cook the chopped onion for 5 mins until soft.
Zeeuwse bolussen: This is a spectacular Dessert dish that prominently features yeast and milk. It also brings together the flavors of sugar, flour and egg to create a perfectly balanced profile. Place the dried yeast, milk and sugar in the bowl of your food processor. Mix and let stand for a few minutes until it begins to foam. Then add the flour, egg, butter, salt, 1 tsp of cinnamon and cardamom and process until smooth.
Zemiakové Placky: This is a spectacular Slovakia Side dish that prominently features potatoes and onion.
